title: Crossbeat Clap
generation_prompt: Produce one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo LIQUID DRUM AND BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 174 BPM in 4/4. The FULL rhythmic arrangement starts at timestamp zero: short kick on beats one and three, sharp dry snare on beats two and four, crisp eighth-note hats, audible syncopated clap and short pitched mallet or keyboard hits on every quarter beat. Maintain the SAME clear beat level throughout 128 seconds, especially 0-16 and 112-128. No fade-in, drumless break, half-time change, quiet passage, tempo drift, filtered outro or silent final bars. Signature hook: two bright clipped notes come from opposite sides, meet on the clap, then answer with four descending notes. Round bass and soft minor-seventh pads support but never mask the transients. At 64 seconds keep the exact drum grid, change bass roots, reverse the hook's travel and answer with a new syncopated three-note figure; vary phrases until the final beat. Kinetic and friendly, controlled highs, no harsh distortion. No vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Crossbeat Clap, a fast all-ages drum-and-bass rhythm-game track. High-contrast comic-print cut-paper style in near-black ink, warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red and sparse halftone. Main motif: exactly TWO simplified flat WARM-IVORY HAND-PALM silhouettes mirrored left and right, each with a broad angular palm and five short geometric fingers, approaching a clap at the central beat point. A single electric-cyan zigzag frequency line enters behind each palm and collides into ONE coral diamond burst at the center; use only a few large shards. Keep hands and central burst fully within the middle 60% of the square to read in a narrow 100px mobile card, with dark lower fifth for local title overlay. Graphic, friendly, non-realistic, clearly a clap rather than fighting. No bodies, faces, weapons, scenery, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art.
